text:
Alice: Quick async check — end-of-quarter milestone roll: runtime-v2 canary + model-routing + console rollouts. Please reply with one-line status: shipped/slipped/pending + CR status + next action. @Ben @Carla @Drew
Ben: runtime-v2: canary deployed to staging 03:15 PT yesterday. Perf stable. CR: PR 542 needs final review from @Drew. Docs: in progress. Next: promote to canary-prod after CR. :white_check_mark:
Drew: I can review PR 542 today, aiming EOD. assign to me.
Ben: thanks — I've added you as reviewer.
Carla: model-routing: slipped by 2d. blocker is storage sharding bug; SRE triaged, fix in review. Owner: Carla. CR for routing changes pending (PR 88), needs product sign-off on flow.
Alice: what's the product sign-off needed? quick bullet?
Carla: acceptance: fallback routing with 99% of old traffic, config flags, e2e smoke. I'll post checklist.
Carla: (posting checklist)
```
- fallback flag
- config migration script
- e2e smoke tests green
- rollout timeline
```
Ben: console metrics: token latency SLOs look okay in staging, watch 95p. I'll add dashboard alerts.
Drew: deploy-bot: canary-prod promotion queued when PR merged.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary-prod promotion queued by Ben — awaiting approvals.
Alice: OK. Owners: Ben (runtime), Carla (routing), Drew (sre/deploy). If anyone needs help ping ops on #eng-oncall. I'll compile a single follow-up doc and set a 1-hr sync if needed. Thanks :pray:
Ben: moving CR to review, will update thread when merged.
Carla: working on fix, ETA tomorrow morning.
Drew: review done, left small comments. will re-check after updates.
Alice: perfect — I'll mark this as the async status. If anything slips further, mark with :warning: and call out blockers.
Ben: :thumbsup:
Carla: :thumbsup:
